b1-22-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Maybe It Rains
b1-22-01.scenario: Petra asks whether you can go hiking tomorrow. You (Meg) say that it is possible that it will rain tomorrow, and that maybe you will stay at home.
b1-22-01.prompt: Tell Petra that it may rain tomorrow and what you might do.
cues: Say that rain is possible tomorrow
Say what you might do instead
b1-22-01.target: Lehet, hogy holnap esik az eső. Talán otthon maradunk.
b1-22-01.english: It is possible that it will rain tomorrow. Maybe we will stay at home.
b1-22-01.canDo: I can say that something is possible, using lehet, hogy.

b1-22-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Weekend Forecast
b1-22-02.scenario: Petra asks what the weather will be like at the weekend. You (Meg) say that, according to the forecast, it will rain at the weekend, but that there will hardly be any snow.
b1-22-02.prompt: Tell Petra what the forecast says about rain and snow.
cues: Say what the forecast says
Say that it will rain
Say that snow is unlikely
b1-22-02.target: Az előrejelzés szerint a hétvégén esni fog az eső. Hó aligha lesz.
b1-22-02.english: According to the forecast, it will rain at the weekend. There will hardly be any snow.
b1-22-02.canDo: I can make a prediction, using fog + infinitive.

b1-22-03.title: Communicative Challenge: I Doubt It
b1-22-03.scenario: Petra says that the exam will be easy. You (Meg) say that you doubt it, but that you trust that it will go well.
b1-22-03.prompt: Tell Petra that you doubt the exam will be easy and that you trust it will go well.
cues: Say that you doubt it
Say that you trust it will go well
b1-22-03.target: Kétlem, hogy könnyű lesz a vizsga. Bízom benne, hogy jól fog menni.
b1-22-03.english: I doubt that the exam will be easy. I trust that it will go well.
b1-22-03.canDo: I can say that I doubt something, using kétlem, hogy.

b1-22-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Will Károly Come?
b1-22-04.scenario: Petra asks whether Károly will come to the party. You (Meg) say that it is conceivable that he will come, but that it is out of the question that he will come early.
b1-22-04.prompt: Tell Petra what is conceivable and what is out of the question.
cues: Say that it is conceivable that he comes to the party
Say that it is out of the question that he comes early
b1-22-04.target: Elképzelhető, hogy Károly eljön a buliba. Kizárt dolog, hogy korán jön.
b1-22-04.english: It is conceivable that Károly will come to the party. It is out of the question that he will come early.
b1-22-04.canDo: I can say that something is conceivable or out of the question, using elképzelhető and kizárt dolog.

b1-22-05.title: Communicative Challenge: In Case It Rains
b1-22-05.scenario: Petra is planning a picnic in the park. You (Meg) say that you will bring an umbrella in case it rains.
b1-22-05.prompt: Tell Petra what you will bring and for which case.
cues: Say what you will bring
Say for which case you bring it
b1-22-05.target: Hozok esernyőt arra az esetre, ha esik az eső.
b1-22-05.english: I am bringing an umbrella in case it rains.
b1-22-05.canDo: I can say what to prepare for, using arra az esetre, ha.

b1-22-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Inventor's Plan
b1-22-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the story about Dávid is about. You (Meg) say that Dávid has a big machine and that in the end his plan comes true.
b1-22-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra what Dávid has and what happens to his plan.
cues: Say what Dávid has
Say that his plan comes true in the end
b1-22-consolidation.target: Dávidnak van egy nagy gépe. Végül valóra válik a terve.
b1-22-consolidation.english: Dávid has a big machine. In the end his plan comes true.
b1-22-consolidation.canDo: I can retell a short story about an inventor and his plan in a few sentences.

b1-23-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Which Offer?
b1-23-01.scenario: Károly asks which of the two offers you have chosen. You (Meg) say that you decided in favor of the new offer and that you made up your mind to accept it.
b1-23-01.prompt: Tell Károly which offer you decided for and what you made up your mind to do.
cues: Say which offer you decided for
Say that you made up your mind to accept it
b1-23-01.target: Az új ajánlat mellett döntöttem. Elhatároztam, hogy elfogadom.
b1-23-01.english: I decided in favor of the new offer. I made up my mind to accept it.
b1-23-01.canDo: I can say what I decided, using dönt + mellett and elhatároz, hogy.

b1-23-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Pros and Cons of the Flat
b1-23-02.scenario: Petra asks whether you will take the new flat. You (Meg) say that on the one hand the flat is cheap, but on the other hand it is far away.
b1-23-02.prompt: Tell Petra one advantage and one disadvantage of the flat.
cues: Say what is good about the flat
Say what is bad about it
b1-23-02.target: Egyrészt olcsó a lakás, másrészt messze van.
b1-23-02.english: On the one hand the flat is cheap, on the other hand it is far away.
b1-23-02.canDo: I can weigh two sides, using egyrészt … másrészt.

b1-23-03.title: Communicative Challenge: In My Place
b1-23-03.scenario: Petra asks what you would do in her place: take the offer or wait. You (Meg) say that in her place you would accept the offer and would not hesitate.
b1-23-03.prompt: Tell Petra what you would do in her place.
cues: Say that you would accept the offer
Say that you would not hesitate
b1-23-03.target: A helyedben elfogadnám az ajánlatot. Nem haboznék.
b1-23-03.english: In your place I would accept the offer. I wouldn't hesitate.
b1-23-03.canDo: I can ask what someone would do in my place, using a helyemben.

b1-23-04.title: Communicative Challenge: My Decision
b1-23-04.scenario: Károly says that the team's decision was a mistake. You (Meg) say that you take responsibility for the decision and suggest a compromise.
b1-23-04.prompt: Tell Károly that you take responsibility and suggest a compromise.
cues: Say that you take responsibility for the decision
Suggest a compromise
b1-23-04.target: Felelősséget vállalok a döntésért. Kössünk kompromisszumot!
b1-23-04.english: I take responsibility for the decision. Let's make a compromise!
b1-23-04.canDo: I can take responsibility for a decision, using felelősséget vállal vmiért.

b1-23-05.title: Communicative Challenge: No Way Back
b1-23-05.scenario: Petra asks whether you are really sure about moving. You (Meg) say that it is time to put an end to the uncertainty and that there is no way back.
b1-23-05.prompt: Tell Petra that the matter is closed.
cues: Say that it is time to end the uncertainty
Say that there is no way back
b1-23-05.target: Ideje pontot tenni a bizonytalanság végére. Nincs visszaút!
b1-23-05.english: It is time to put an end to the uncertainty. There is no way back!
b1-23-05.canDo: I can say that a decision is final, using pontot tesz az ügy végére and nincs visszaút.

b1-23-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Judge of Lőcse
b1-23-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the story about the town of Lőcse is about. You (Meg) say that the judge stands by his decision and takes responsibility.
b1-23-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra what the judge does.
cues: Say that he stands by his decision
Say that he takes responsibility
b1-23-consolidation.target: A bíró kitart a döntése mellett. Vállalja a felelősséget.
b1-23-consolidation.english: The judge stands by his decision. He takes responsibility.
b1-23-consolidation.canDo: I can retell a short story about a judge's hard decision in a few sentences.

b1-24-01.title: Communicative Challenge: It Solved Itself
b1-24-01.scenario: Petra asks what happened with the broken computer. You (Meg) say that you restarted the machine and the problem solved itself.
b1-24-01.prompt: Tell Petra what you did and what happened to the problem.
cues: Say that you restarted the machine
Say that the problem solved itself
b1-24-01.target: Újraindítottuk a gépet. A probléma magától megoldódott.
b1-24-01.english: We restarted the machine. The problem solved itself.
b1-24-01.canDo: I can say that a process happens by itself, using verbs like megoldódik and átalakul.

b1-24-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What the Machine Consists Of
b1-24-02.scenario: Károly asks what the new machine consists of. You (Meg) say that it consists of three parts and that the parts fit together exactly.
b1-24-02.prompt: Tell Károly what the machine consists of and how the parts fit.
cues: Say that the machine consists of three parts
Say that the parts fit together exactly
b1-24-02.target: A gép három részből áll. A részek pontosan illeszkednek.
b1-24-02.english: The machine consists of three parts. The parts fit together exactly.
b1-24-02.canDo: I can say what something consists of, using áll vmiből.

b1-24-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The New Medicine
b1-24-03.scenario: Petra asks about the new medicine her grandmother takes. You (Meg) say that the medicine has a good effect on the patients.
b1-24-03.prompt: Tell Petra what effect the medicine has.
cues: Say what the medicine has
Say who it works on
b1-24-03.target: A gyógyszer jó hatást fejt ki a betegekre.
b1-24-03.english: The medicine has a good effect on the patients.
b1-24-03.canDo: I can say that something has an effect on something else, using hatást gyakorol vmire and kölcsönhatásba lép vmivel.

b1-24-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Breakdown at Work
b1-24-04.scenario: Károly says the machine at his workplace stopped. You (Meg) say that the experts quickly cleared the breakdown and that the machine now works with greater efficiency.
b1-24-04.prompt: Tell Károly what the experts did and how the machine works now.
cues: Say that the experts cleared the breakdown
Say that the machine now works with greater efficiency
b1-24-04.target: A szakemberek gyorsan elhárították az üzemzavart. A gép nagyobb hatékonysággal működik.
b1-24-04.english: The experts quickly cleared the breakdown. The machine works with greater efficiency.
b1-24-04.canDo: I can say that a breakdown occurred and was fixed, using üzemzavar lép fel and elhárít.

b1-24-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Step by Step
b1-24-05.scenario: Petra asks how to start the new program. You (Meg) say that first you check the connection, then you start the program, and finally you look at the result.
b1-24-05.prompt: Explain the three steps to Petra.
cues: Say what to do first
Say what to do next
Say what to do last
b1-24-05.target: Először ellenőrizzük a csatlakozást, ezután indítsuk el a programot. Végezetül nézzük meg az eredményt.
b1-24-05.english: First let's check the connection, then let's start the program. Finally let's look at the result.
b1-24-05.canDo: I can explain a procedure step by step, using először, ezután and végezetül.

b1-24-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The School as a Machine
b1-24-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks Meg what the story about the boys at the military school is about. You (Meg) say that the school works like a machine, but the boys stay friends.
b1-24-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra how the school works and what the boys do.
cues: Say that the school works like a machine
Say that the boys stay friends
b1-24-consolidation.target: Az iskola gépezetként működik. A fiúk barátok maradnak.
b1-24-consolidation.english: The school works like a machine. The boys stay friends.
b1-24-consolidation.canDo: I can retell a short story about a school that works like a machine in a few sentences.
